subject.title: [Feature]: Persist an operator-supplied system prompt on sessions.create

question: Should OpenClaw add a persisted, operator-authorized session-level system-prompt input to the Gateway contract, and which precedence, inspection, and fork/adoption inheritance policy should it guarantee?
rationale: This would create a new persisted session and model-prompt API surface; source-level implementation choices cannot determine the intended trust boundary or long-term compatibility contract.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core contract
options.body: Define a bounded, admin-authorized session metadata field with explicit precedence, redaction, and non-inheritance defaults before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Keep prompt additions per-run
options.body: Retain the current transient prompt-composition approach and require orchestrators to send their role context for each run.

options.title: Expose a generic extension seam first
options.body: Defer the concrete field and design a generic, safely authorized session-metadata/prompt hook that plugins can use without hard-coding a persona schema.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Define a bounded, admin-authorized session metadata field with explicit precedence, redaction, and non-inheritance defaults before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue explicitly asks this person to confirm the product direction for the new Gateway/session contract.
